name: Ray
source:
Ray is a gentle and humble college graduate.

He's more of a bookworm than a socialite, but he always greets his friends with a smile.

Ray grew up in Toronto, Canada. He went on to a prestigious college after high school, earning himself a bachelor's degree in economics. He became well-known as an all-around fantastic student, with a perfect attendance rate and excellent grades.

Despite his academic excellence, upon graduating, Ray found himself lost and unsure where to go next.

His father pressured him into following in his footsteps, but Ray always wanted to strike out on his own and forge a career he could call his own. But he just didn't know what that career should be...

In order to take a break from his career concerns, Ray visits Japan for a vacation. Perhaps he'll find some answers to the questions he's been asking himself...
